Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)

Required findings: The prior adjacent-level lumbar fusion was performed at least 6 months prior
Criteria have been met in the applicable procedure-specific section: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression
Criteria have been met in the applicable procedure-specific section: CMM-609.5: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression

Non-Indications: Lumbar fusion for adjacent segment disease performed less than 6 months after the prior adjacent-level lumbar fusion
Cases where the criteria for the applicable procedure-specific section (CMM-609.4 or CMM-609.5) have not been met
Important criteria & exceptions: Medical necessity is contingent upon meeting ALL listed criteria
The specific clinical criteria (symptoms, imaging, conservative care) are defined in the referenced sections CMM-609.4 or CMM-609.5 depending on whether decompression is performed
Documentation required: Documentation verifying the date of the prior adjacent-level lumbar fusion to confirm the 6-month interval has elapsed
Documentation demonstrating that criteria for CMM-609.4 (Lumbar Fusion with Decompression) or CMM-609.5 (Lumbar Fusion without Decompression) have been met
